style.selfie: Handheld front-lens vlog footage, ultra-wide 0.5x lens, natural wide-angle handheld perspective, subtle hand shake, auto-exposure, photorealistic documentary realism. The lens sits at the end of Nora's outstretched right arm, about 60 cm in front of her face, looking back at her; her right shoulder and upper arm reach toward the bottom-right corner and leave the frame there, so her right hand is never in view.
style.run: Handheld front-lens vlog footage, ultra-wide 0.5x lens, natural wide-angle handheld perspective, auto-exposure, photorealistic documentary realism. The lens sits at the end of Nora's outstretched right arm, held at chest/mid-torso level angled slightly upward looking back at Nora; this dynamic angle captures her face, her plunging low-cut cleavage, tiny waist, and long slender legs, emphasizing her tall statuesque height. Her right shoulder and upper arm reach toward the bottom-right corner and leave the frame there, so her right hand is never in view. Her right arm stays extended toward the lens for the entire clip while she runs; only her left arm pumps. Raw unstabilized footage: because the lens is in Nora's own outstretched right hand, every stride she takes jolts the whole frame — her face jumps up and down by about a tenth of the frame height and the horizon behind her tilts a few degrees left and right, with a brief motion blur on each footfall, while her face always stays in the frame.

The hand holds still with steady pressure; the skin of his cheek dents slightly under her palm; Torak looks down at the hand, then slowly nods once.
Just a warm hand, steady, and wait.
The hand withdraws; at 9s Torak steps sideways right across the lens from left to right, his parka filling the frame.
Okay... he's letting me.
clips.physics: The mitten swings on its cord with inertia as her hand moves.
clips.tin: her hand enters from the bottom
clips.tout: POV wipe: Torak's parka crosses the lens
clips.join: CUT when his parka covers the frame; S06 jump cut
clips.audio: wind, faint rustle of hide, Nora's low voice

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie at arm's length in an open space between dwellings, Alva at Nora's right
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie at arm's length between the dwellings; Nora's face left of centre; Alva stands at her right side; a fur mitten hangs on a hide cord from Nora's left wrist.
seg: Alva takes the hide cord at Nora's left wrist and tugs it twice; Nora's wrist jerks slightly with each tug.
Hour two. Alva keeps checking this cord. Twice now.
Alva nods once, satisfied; Nora half-smiles into the camera, the mitten swinging on its cord.
Mittens. All four fingers share the heat.
Nora lifts the mitten to show it; at 9.5s she swings the camera fast to the left in a motion blur.
And drop one in this wind, it's gone.
clips.physics: The cord pulls tight, then goes slack.
clips.tout: whip pan left, motion blur in the last half second
clips.join: CUT in the blur; S07 opens mid-swing to the left
clips.audio: wind, muffled camp sounds

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie at arm's length walking slowly backward alongside a dwelling, the jaw wall on the left of the frame
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie at arm's length beside a mammoth-bone dwelling, motion blur settling; on the left of the frame the dwelling's wall base of mammoth lower jaws stacked in a tight zigzag; Nora's face right of centre.
seg: The frame settles from a leftward swing onto Nora, who walks slowly backward alongside the dwelling at about half a metre per second.
Lower jaws, stacked in that zigzag.
The jaw wall slides slowly past on the left as she walks; thin smoke rises from the top of the dome and bends in the wind.
I've walked around the museum reconstruction maybe fifty times.
She glances up at the smoke, grins, then shakes her head at herself.
Never once with smoke coming out the top. Okay, okay, focus.
clips.physics: The dwelling is solid and completely still; it only slides past because she walks. Slight vertical bounce with each step.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: wind, crunching snow, crackle from inside the dwelling

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie at arm's length in front of a dwelling entrance arched with tusks
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie at arm's length in front of a dwelling entrance; a pair of curved mammoth tusks arch over a low hide-covered doorway on the right; Nora's face on the left.
seg: Nora stands in front of the tusk-arched entrance and speaks low.
Real talk, we still argue what these were.
The hide flap over the doorway sways slightly in the wind; she glances at it.
Homes, food stores, maybe monuments. Newer dating says people weren't here long.

At 7s she lifts the edge of the hide flap behind her shoulder with her free hand: inside, in dim firelight, a person lies asleep under furs; at 9s she ducks through the flap, the back of her head fills the frame and the image goes dark.
This one? Someone's asleep in it.
clips.physics: The tusk arch and the dwelling stay completely still. The sleeper is inside the dwelling from the first second and only breathes slowly; nobody appears suddenly.
clips.tout: walk-through: she ducks through the hide flap and the frame goes dark
clips.join: CUT on dark; S09 opens from dark inside
clips.audio: wind, rustle of the hide flap, faint sleeping breath inside

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie inside the dwelling, the hearth behind Nora
clips.frame0: Inside the dwelling, the frame brightening from dark into firelight; Nora's face lit warm on the left; the central bone hearth behind her with Alva sitting beside it.
seg: The image brightens from dark into warm firelight; Nora rubs her cold free hand on her sleeve.
Wood's scarce out here, so Alva burns bone.
Behind her, Alva places a greasy mammoth bone end onto the hearth beside a few thin burning twigs; the flames lick up slowly around it.
The greasy ends, mostly. We find barely any charcoal in these hearths.
Fat on the bone sizzles softly and smoke rises toward the smoke hole; at 9s Nora reaches her free hand toward the lens.
That's why, probably.
clips.physics: The flames catch gradually, with no burst; there are no logs, the fire is mostly bone with a few thin twigs.
clips.tout: her hand reaches toward the lens
clips.join: CUT; S10 POV with her hand
clips.audio: crackling bone fire, soft sizzle of fat, wind outside

clips.hand: only her bare hand, holding nothing but a scoop of snow, enters the lower frame
clips.shot: First-person view sitting by the hearth
clips.frame0: First-person view sitting inside the dwelling near the hearth; Nora's bare hand at the bottom of the frame holding a scoop of snow; Alva sitting on the left by the fire.
seg: Nora's bare hand lifts the scoop of snow toward the lens.
Yeah, I know, I know.
Alva's hand comes in from the left and gently stops Nora's wrist; Alva shakes her head; snow crumbles from the palm.
Don't eat snow, ever. Your body spends its own heat melting it.
Nora lowers her hand and lets the snow fall; at 9s steam from a hide water bag drifts across the lens and fogs the frame.
I was testing her. Mostly.
clips.physics: Snow falls loosely from her palm.
clips.tin: her hand already in the lower frame
clips.join: CUT in the steam; S11 opens as the steam clears
clips.audio: fire crackle, Nora's laugh

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie inside, the hide water bag behind Nora's left shoulder
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie inside the dwelling, steam clearing; a hide water bag hanging from a bone tripod behind Nora's left shoulder; Alva beside it gripping a fire-blackened hot stone between two bone sticks.
seg: Alva lowers the hot stone with the bone sticks into the hide bag.
Hot stone into a hide bag.
Water bubbles rapidly around the submerged stone and steam rises gradually; the bag sags slightly under the stone's weight.
Hide can't sit on a flame, it burns. We dig up heat-cracked rock
Nora nods at the bag as the steam slowly thickens.
at sites like this. Probably from exactly this.
clips.physics: The stone is dark grey and fire-blackened, hot but not glowing; a thin wisp of steam curls off it before it touches the water. Only localized bubbling around the stone, no instant violent boil; steam rises by convection.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: hiss and bubbling water, fire crackle

clips.shot: Locked-off frame from a bone ledge about half a metre high, looking level at Nora by the hearth
seg: Alva hands Nora a lump of soft white fat together with a strip of meat.
Every bite of meat, she hands me a lump of fat.
Nora chews, talking fast with her mouth half full.
Lean meat alone in this cold makes you sick. The fat's the actual fuel.
She grimaces at the taste, then keeps eating; Alva watches, amused.
Tastes like candle.
clips.physics: The fat is soft and squashes slightly in her fingers.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: fire crackle, chewing

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie outside beside a dwelling, the covered pit behind Nora's left shoulder
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie outside beside a dwelling; behind Nora's left shoulder Torak kneels at a shallow pit covered with a stiff frozen hide.
seg: Torak grips the edge of the hide cover.
Hour four. These pits ring every hut.
He lifts the stiff frozen hide from left to right; snow slides off it and frozen chunks of meat are revealed inside the pit.
We dig them out full of bone. Ground's frozen year-round here,
Nora leans to look, eyebrows up; at 9.5s she swings the camera fast to the right.
so most of us think: freezers. And... yep. Meat.
clips.physics: The frozen hide is stiff and bends only at the corner; the meat is in the pit from the start.
clips.join: CUT in the blur; S15 opens mid-swing
clips.audio: wind, creak of frozen hide

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie, a pelt-stretching frame behind Nora
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie, motion blur settling; behind Nora, Torak stretches white arctic-fox pelts with the tails still on across a frame of bones.
seg: The frame settles on Nora; behind her Torak pulls a sinew cord tight on a fox pelt.
Fox pelts, tails still on.
The pelts stretch taut, their bushy tails swaying in the wind.
We find tons of fox bones at this site and wondered why.
Nora shrugs at the camera, deadpan.
Not dinner. Coats. Maybe also dinner.
clips.physics: The pelts stretch and the fur ripples in the wind.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: wind, sinew cord creaking

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie held a little high, Alva at Nora's right, the fox-tooth belt at the bottom edge
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie held a little high; Alva stands at Nora's right; Nora's wide leather belt sewn with rows of drilled arctic-fox canine teeth is visible at the bottom edge of the frame.
seg: Alva points at Nora's belt.
She likes my belt.
Alva bends and touches one fox tooth with a fingertip; the teeth click softly against each other.
Fox canines, drilled and sewn on. Copied from a burial at Sungir,
Alva straightens up, nods and smiles slightly; Nora grins proudly.
way north of here, over two hundred teeth. Nailed it, apparently.
clips.physics: The teeth swing and tap together lightly.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: wind, soft clicking of teeth

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie on open snowy steppe, Nora and Torak dragging a bone
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie on open snowy steppe; Nora and, behind her, Torak both grip one long mammoth leg bone lying in the snow.
seg: Nora (with her free hand) and Torak drag the heavy bone slowly sideways to the left, leaning forward with short steps; the bone carves a groove in the snow.
Hour six. Hauling bone makes me sweat, and damp fur stops insulating.
Nora stops and, with her free hand, loosens the leather ties at her neckline.
So I open up before I'm hot, not after.
She tilts the camera toward Torak, whose collar is already open.
Torak's already done it.
clips.physics: The bone is heavy: both lean forward and move slowly; the snow is pushed aside into a groove. Her curtain bangs are damp and stuck to her forehead and her breath comes in heavy puffs; when she loosens the ties a gust lifts the fur edge of her hood and she shivers once.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: wind, scraping bone on snow, heavy breathing

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie at the edge of a shallow ravine, Torak below behind Nora's shoulder
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie at the edge of a shallow ravine on the steppe; below, behind Nora's shoulder, Torak stands at an old weathered pile of mammoth bones half buried in snow.
seg: Torak grips a weathered tusk sticking out of the pile with both hands.
Big debate in my field:
He pulls; the tusk inches out, the snow cracks around it and frozen chunks fall.
did they hunt all these mammoths, or collect bones from old natural piles?
The tusk comes free; it is grey and cracked with age.
This one's been dead for years. So today, collecting.
clips.physics: The tusk comes out bit by bit, not all at once; the bone pile is there from the first second.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: wind, cracking frozen snow, Torak grunting

clips.note: Tê giác lông mịn (Coelodonta antiquitatis). Còn sống ở Đông Âu thời Cực đại Băng hà, vùng phân bố trùng với ma mút. Sừng trước dẹt ngang, có vết mài do gạt tuyết khi ăn cỏ.
clips.shot: Low ultra-wide selfie behind a snow drift, Torak at Nora's right, the rhino about forty metres behind them
clips.frame0: Low ultra-wide selfie, Nora crouched behind a low snow drift on the open steppe; Torak crouches at her right; about forty metres behind them a lone woolly rhinoceros grazes with its head low, its long flattened front horn brushing the snow.
seg: Torak presses a flat hand down, then traces a wide curve in the air around the rhino; Nora nods without a sound.
Woolly rhino. Torak wants a very wide circle around it.
Behind them the rhino swings its low head slowly from side to side, its broad flat front horn brushing snow off the dry grass, then tears up a mouthful.
See the front horn? Flat, worn sideways. It sweeps the snow off the grass.
The rhino lifts its head and stares in their general direction, ears turning, and stays where it is; Nora sinks lower behind the drift.
Fossil horns show that wear too. It's looking. We're leaving.
clips.physics: The rhino is heavy and slow: its feet compress the snow and its long shaggy reddish-brown coat sways a moment after each head movement. It stays about forty metres away the whole time and never charges or comes closer. The front horn is long, flattened sideways and curves forward; a shorter second horn sits behind it.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: wind, the rhino's snorting breath, crunch of snow and tearing grass

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie on the steppe, wind from the right
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie on the steppe; wind blowing snow low across the ground from right to left; far behind, Torak walks away toward the camp with his back to the camera.
seg: The wind gusts harder and snow streams across the frame; Nora squints and leans into the wind.
Wind's picking up— sh— that's the real killer, not the temperature.
Far behind her Torak keeps walking away, getting smaller.
Same cold, twice the wind, you lose heat way faster.
At 9s a gust of blown snow sweeps over and covers the lens completely.
Torak's already heading in.
clips.physics: Nora leans into the wind but her feet stay planted; Torak only gets smaller as he walks away.
clips.join: CUT on white; S21 opens as the snow melts off the lens
clips.audio: howling wind, hissing snow

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie inside the dwelling, Alva behind Nora by the hearth
clips.frame0: Inside the dwelling; the frame is white with snow on the lens, clearing to show Nora in firelight; Alva behind her by the hearth.
seg: The snow melts off the lens; Nora brushes snow from her hood fur with her free hand.
Hour eight. Warm hands in your armpits, not over the fire.
She tucks her free left hand into her right armpit, shivering.
Numb skin can't feel a burn.
Behind her, Alva also sits with both hands tucked into her armpits.
Alva's doing the same thing, so I'm in good company.
clips.physics: Snow drops off the hood fur in small clumps.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: fire crackle, wind outside, chattering teeth

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie on the terrace, the terrace edge behind Nora
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie on the terrace in afternoon light; behind Nora, Torak is already walking toward her from the terrace edge.
seg: Torak walks toward Nora at walking pace, growing larger.
Hour nine. Torak's back from the ridge,
He swings one arm low in front of his face like an elephant's trunk, then points down toward the valley.
arm swinging low like a trunk. Herd. And he wants me along.
He beckons her to follow; Nora raises her eyebrows at the camera.
Not sure if that's trust or bait.
clips.physics: His boots sink into the snow with each step.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: wind, crunching steps

clips.shot: From Nora's raised hand just behind her right shoulder, looking forward along the trail; Torak walks about three metres ahead
seg: Both walk slowly; Nora steps exactly into Torak's footprints.
Walk in his tracks. Saves energy,
Torak glances at the wind direction and keeps going, the camera bouncing gently with Nora's steps.
and he knows where the crust holds. We stay downwind too.
At 9s Nora turns her head to look over the top of the rise.
Mammoths probably smell like elephants: way better than they see.
clips.physics: The snow crust cracks under each boot; both move at a slow walking pace.
clips.join: CUT; S24 opens behind her head on the rise
clips.audio: wind, crust cracking under boots

clips.shot: From just behind Nora's head, the back of her head on the left, the valley on the right (Reveal #1)
seg: Nora stays still; the herd far below walks slowly to the left, staying small and far away.
Oh. Oh, there they are.
Nora lowers herself and shifts slowly to the left, revealing the whole herd; calves walk in the middle between the adults.
Eight, nine... calves in the middle. That's textbook elephant behaviour.
At 9s the camera swings smoothly forward over the valley in a motion blur.
I did not expect textbook to be this big.
clips.physics: The herd is in the frame from the first second and never gets closer; nothing pops into view. The valley is completely still.
clips.tout: camera swings forward in a blur
clips.join: CUT in the blur; S25 opens mid-swing on the herd
clips.audio: wind, distant low mammoth rumbles

clips.shot: Handheld view from the ridge across the valley at medium distance, slow pan left to right, from the mammoths to the steppe bison grazing beside them
clips.frame0: Handheld view from a snowy ridge across the valley at medium distance: woolly mammoths grazing with heads low, pushing through shallow snow for grass; at the right edge of the frame a few steppe bison graze beside them.
seg: The camera settles from a swing and pans slowly left to right across the herd, past a female with very small furry ears half hidden in her hair.
Look at the ears. Tiny. No wonder.
The mammoths walk very slowly, tusks occasionally pushing through shallow snow; long coarse guard hairs sway in the wind over a dense woolly undercoat.
Shaggy hair outside, thick wool under.
The pan reaches a small herd of steppe bison grazing next to the mammoths, with long, wide horns curving forward.
Steppe bison too. Both gone now.
clips.physics: Their feet compress the snow before the heavy bodies shift. The ears are very small, about thirty centimetres, tucked close to the head. The herd stays at the same distance. The bison graze calmly at the same distance and stay a separate group from the mammoths.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: wind, low rumbles, crunch of snow under huge feet, a bison's grunt

clips.shot: Low ultra-wide selfie just above the snow, Nora lying behind a snow ridge, Torak on her right, the herd far behind
clips.frame0: Low ultra-wide selfie just above the snow: Nora lies on her stomach behind a low snow ridge; Torak lies to her right; far behind them across the valley the mammoth herd, the largest female in front; off to the left, a steep riverbank with an icy lip.
seg: Torak presses his flat hand downward twice, signalling stay low, then points firmly toward the steep icy riverbank off to the left and holds Nora's eye; Nora nods.
Stay low, he says. And he's pointing at that bank.
Far behind them, the largest female slowly raises her trunk high, curling the tip, sniffing the air; she stands still.
No, wait— lead female, probably, trunk up, sniffing.
Nora whispers into the camera with wide eyes, glancing back at the herd.
She's testing the wind. Is our wind still good?
clips.physics: The trunk curls up slowly; the herd stays far away and does not move closer.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: wind, a distant snort

clips.shot: Low ultra-wide selfie just above the snow, Nora crawling on her elbows, Torak behind
clips.frame0: Low ultra-wide selfie just above the snow: Nora on her elbows crawling; Torak lying behind her shoulder; the mammoth herd far off on the right side of the frame.
seg: Nora crawls forward on her elbows about one metre, elbows sinking into the snow.
Real talk, I need a closer shot. Fifty metres, max.
Behind her Torak shakes his head and reaches a hand toward her without touching her.
He's shaking his head. I know. I know.
She keeps crawling; at 9s she turns the camera away from her face toward the herd in a blur.
Ten more steps and I'm done.
clips.physics: Her elbows leave dents in the snow; the herd stays far away.
clips.join: CUT; S28 POV low over the snow
clips.audio: wind, snow crunching under elbows

clips.shot: First-person view low just above the snow crust
clips.frame0: First-person view low just above the snow crust, Nora's bare hand pressed flat on the snow at the bottom of the frame; a mammoth calf at medium distance ahead, its mother a little behind it.
seg: The calf wanders slowly toward the camera; the mother keeps grazing.
Calf's wandering this way. Mum's watching it.
The mother mammoth turns her head and looks straight toward the camera; her long hair swings with a delay after the turn.
Mum's watching me now. Okay...
The mother mammoth raises her head high and curls her trunk inward under her tusks, then shifts her weight forward onto her front legs.
head up, trunk tucked, that's the posture. That's the posture before—
clips.physics: Heavy body inertia: her feet compress the snow before the body moves.
clips.tout: cut as the mother shifts her weight forward
clips.join: CUT on the lunge; S29 opens mid-run
clips.audio: wind, a low rumble rising to a trumpet

clips.shot: Ultra-wide running selfie at arm's length, the charging mammoth far behind
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie at arm's length on the snowy steppe at sunset, Nora's face close and frightened; far behind her a female woolly mammoth charging, snow spraying.
seg: Nora runs forward through knee-deep snow with shortened heavy strides, twisting her upper body to look back over her shoulder; far behind her the female mammoth charges, snow spraying from her feet, her outstretched arm jolting the frame hard on every stride.
She's charging— sh— I can't outrun her.
Nora keeps running; the mammoth grows slowly larger in the background but stays far behind and never catches up during the clip, the horizon swinging left and right with each footfall.
Riverbank. Get something big between us.
At 7.5s the camera whips down toward the snow in a blur, her outstretched arm jolting the frame with every stride.
Go, go!
clips.bg: No one else in the shot.
clips.physics: Her boots sink deep and leave raised rims of displaced snow. The mammoth is heavy: feet compress the snow, the body sways with a lag, the long hair bounces. The mammoth moves in heavy, powerful elephant strides, never galloping like a horse and never gliding; each huge foot slams down and compresses the snow before the next lifts, and her bulk rocks with every step.
clips.join: CUT in the blur; S30 opens mid-wade
clips.audio: pounding heavy footfalls, trumpeting, Nora's ragged breathing

clips.shot: First-person view at chest height wading toward the riverbank edge
clips.frame0: First-person view at chest height wading through knee-deep snow at sunset; about ten metres ahead the edge of a steep riverbank; Torak stands on it waving one arm.
seg: The camera pushes forward slowly at wading speed, bouncing hard with each heavy step.
Knee-deep, I can't run, just big heavy steps.
Snow bulges up around each step; the bank edge gets closer; Torak waves urgently.
The bank's right there, Torak's waving.
At the edge the view tips forward and drops over the lip, sliding down the snowy slope, snow spraying across the frame; only snow, sky and the slope fill the frame.
Go.
clips.physics: Natural vertical bounce synchronized to each step; the camera only moves at slow wading speed.
clips.tout: camera pitches down over the lip
clips.join: CUT; S31 opens as she slides down
clips.audio: heavy breathing, snow crunching, distant trumpeting

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie pointing up, Nora pressed against the bank wall
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie pointing up: Nora pressed with her back against a steep snowy riverbank wall about three metres high; above her the bank's top lip glazed with smooth shiny ice against the sunset sky.
seg: Nora finishes sliding down the bank and stops, snow trickling after her; she presses her back to the wall.
Down, down, down. Steep bank, glazed ice on the lip.
Above, the female mammoth approaches the top of the bank at a run, so her head and shoulders appear gradually over the lip as she gets closer.
Something that heavy can't get footing on that.
Nora looks up, breathing hard.
Probably. Please, probably.
clips.bg: No one else in the shot.
clips.physics: Snow trickles down after her slide; the bank wall is solid and still.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: thudding footfalls above, Nora's breathing

clips.shot: Low-angle ultra-wide selfie pointing up past Nora's face toward the bank's icy top lip about three metres above
clips.frame0: Low ultra-wide selfie pointing upward past Nora's face toward the top lip of the riverbank about three metres above, glazed with shiny ice; the female mammoth arriving at the top edge.
seg: The mammoth's front feet land on the glazed ice lip and the footing fails; her front feet slide forward while her heavy body keeps coming.
Oh no no no— she's slipping, she's slipping—
Her shoulders and head swing to the right, her hind legs dig into the snow to brace, and her whole body skids sideways along the lip, losing momentum.
she's turning.
Slowed down, she steps back off the ice hind legs first, turns away to the right and disappears beyond the top edge; snow and ice fragments tumble down past Nora's face.
She's turning away!
clips.bg: No one else in the shot.
clips.physics: This is a deflection, not a stop: the footing fails first, the body mass carries on and lags behind, then the momentum bleeds off over several heavy steps. There is no instant reversal and no spin; she never skids to a halt like a car and never comes down the bank. Nora stays pressed against the wall.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: scraping ice, heavy thud, trumpet, falling ice

clips.shot: First-person view from just below the bank lip, looking up and out
clips.frame0: First-person view from just below the riverbank lip looking up and out over the snow: the female mammoth running away toward the distant herd at sunset.
seg: The mammoth trots heavily away toward the herd and her calf, getting smaller, snow kicking up behind her feet.
Back to her calf.
Her long hair bounces with each stride as she shrinks into the distance.
That was a warning charge.
At 5s Torak's mittened hand reaches down from above across the lens.
I think.
clips.physics: The mammoth only gets smaller; she never turns back.
clips.join: CUT on the hand; S34 opens with Torak pulling her up
clips.audio: fading thuds, wind

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie on the riverbank slope, Torak above gripping Nora's left forearm
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie on the riverbank slope at sunset; Torak above gripping Nora's left forearm.
seg: Torak pulls Nora up the bank by her left forearm; she scrambles up about a metre, the camera shaking.
Okay, okay. Hand, yes, thank you.
Torak is laughing silently as he hauls her onto the top.
He's... laughing at me. Fair.
Nora, on her knees at the top, laughs shakily into the camera.
I just did everything I tell my students never to do.
clips.physics: Her right hand never lets go of the camera; the frame shakes as she climbs.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: snow scraping, breathing, wind

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie, Nora sitting in the snow at the top of the bank, Torak crouching on her left
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie at sunset; Nora sits in the snow at the top of the riverbank, hands trembling; Torak crouches on her left.
seg: The frame trembles slightly with her shaking hand.
Hour thirteen. Hands won't stop shaking. Probably adrenaline, not just the cold.
Torak holds out a lump of white fat; she takes it with her free hand.
Eat something, sit, breathe slow.
She gives a tired laugh; at 9s she turns her head to look toward the valley.
Torak's handing me fat. Of course he is.
clips.physics: The camera shakes only slightly with her trembling hand.
clips.join: CUT; S36 opens behind her head
clips.audio: wind, slowing breath

clips.shot: From just behind Nora's head looking down at the bank and valley, then turning to a selfie
seg: The herd keeps walking away, small and getting smaller; the sun sinks low.
Torak knew.
Nora brings the camera around to face herself, calm now; the light shifts from orange toward blue.
He knew that bank wouldn't hold her.
She glances to the side toward Torak and nods slowly.
He picked it.
clips.physics: The slide marks are there from the first second; the herd only gets smaller.
clips.join: CUT, time-skip
clips.audio: wind dying down, distant rumbles

clips.shot: Ultra-wide selfie as Nora ducks into the dwelling, Alva at the hearth behind her
clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie, nearly dark, Nora ducking through a hide flap into the dwelling, firelight rising behind her; Alva sits at the hearth behind her.
seg: Nora pushes through the hide flap into warm firelight and sits down.
Hour fifteen. Alva heard. Everyone heard.
Behind her Alva strikes a long mammoth leg bone on a stone anvil with a stone hammer; cracks radiate from the impact point.
She's cracking a leg bone for me,
The bone splits open; at 9s Nora reaches her free hand toward it.
which I'm choosing to read as 'welcome to the family'.
clips.physics: The bone cracks progressively from the impact point before it splits.
clips.join: CUT; S38 POV
clips.audio: fire crackle, sharp knock of stone on bone

seg: Nora's hand scoops marrow slowly with the bone spatula.
Marrow. Basically pure fat. We find long bones

smashed open at sites like this. That exact break, right through the shaft.
The spatula leaves the frame toward her mouth; Alva watches.
And now I'm eating it.
clips.physics: The marrow is soft and sticky and clings to the spatula.

clips.shot: First-person view sitting by the hearth, looking down at a soaked hide boot
clips.frame0: First-person view sitting by the hearth at night, looking down at a dark, soaked fur-lined hide boot lying on a fur hide; Nora's bare hand entering from below; Alva on the left holding a bundle of dry golden grass.
seg: Nora's bare hand pulls a wad of wet, matted grass out of the boot; a few drops of water fall from it.
Soaked at the riverbank. Wet feet lose heat fast.
Alva's hand passes the bundle of dry golden grass from the left; Nora's hand takes it and pushes it down into the boot.
Dry grass inside, it pulls moisture and traps warm air.
Her hand sets the boot upright on the floor beside the hearth stones, about an arm's length from the flames; faint steam rises from the damp hide.
The Alps Iceman lined his shoes like this.
clips.physics: The wet grass is dark and limp; the dry grass is stiff and springy and compresses as it is pushed in; the boot stays at a safe distance from the fire and does not burn.
clips.join: CUT; S40 opens on a static frame
clips.audio: fire crackle, rustle of dry grass, dripping water

clips.shot: Locked-off frame from a bone ledge, Nora, Alva and the hearth
seg: Alva pats a fur hide on the floor at the spot close to the wall beside the fire.
Alva's giving me a spot by the fire now.
Nora shuffles over and sits down there, wrapping her arms around her knees.
Near the wall, not the door. I know what that means.
She wipes her eye with the back of her hand, smiling.
I'm not crying, it's the smoke.
clips.physics: Smoke rises by convection toward the smoke hole.
clips.join: CUT
clips.audio: fire crackle, soft rustle of furs

clips.frame0: Ultra-wide selfie by the fire; behind Nora's right shoulder Alva sews a fox pelt with a thin eyed bone needle.
seg: Alva pushes the bone needle in and out of the hide steadily without looking at her hands.
Hour seventeen. An eyed bone needle.
Nora leans in close, eyes shining.
I've catalogued broken ones in museum drawers for years, never seen one used.
Nora laughs at herself; at 9s she reaches her free hand toward the edge of the hide.
She's stitching without looking. Sorry. Archaeologist.
clips.delivery: in a whisper, almost choked up
clips.physics: The hide flexes slightly around the needle.
clips.tout: her hand reaches for the hide
clips.join: CUT; S42 POV

She's using the eye. Sinew goes right through.
She pulls the sinew thread tight, then it lies flat in the seam.
Not just punching holes. Real seams, tight enough to stop the wind.
At 9s Alva lifts the pelt up so it covers the lens completely.
Also beads. Lots of beads.

Amber and fossil shells,
Nora leans in to look, excited.
carried here from three to five hundred kilometres away. Some from the Black Sea side.

Way before farming. Way before roads.
clips.physics: The beads swing and click softly.

Hour nineteen. That skull by the entrance. Red ochre,
She tilts her head to look at it, breath vapor fading fast.
dots and lines. I've only seen it in records.
She exhales shakily into the camera.
Okay, breathe.

Listen to that.
He strikes three more slow beats; the bone rebounds slightly after each strike while the skull stays completely still.
Worn dents on top, damaged bones beside it. A drum? We still argue.
Nora grins wide; at 9s she leans toward the skull.
Sounds like a drum to me.

clips.join: CUT; S46 POV
clips.audio: deep hollow knocks on bone, fire crackle

clips.shot: First-person view close to the painted skull
clips.frame0: First-person view close to the painted mammoth skull at night, red ochre dots right in front of the lens; Nora's bare hand entering from below.

Ochre. Iron-rich earth, ground up.
She lifts her hand and turns it: red powder clings to the ridges of her fingertips.
It's still on my fingertips. Eighteen thousand years in the ground and the red survives.
At 9s Torak walks across the lens from left to right, his parka filling the frame.
That's how we found it.
clips.physics: Dry ochre powder sticks to the fingerprint ridges.

Hour twenty-one. Holy cr— eyes past the bone pile.
The pairs of glowing eyes stay still, blinking now and then; one pair slowly backs away.
Wolves. After the scraps, I hope.
At 9s the camera swings away from her toward the camp in a blur.
From here? Wolves.
clips.physics: The eyes are there from the first second; no wolves come closer.

Four dwellings, hearths going, the river frozen below.

On the dig it's a pit with string lines and numbered bags.

This is what the string lines meant.

Clear sky, colder night. Heat just radiates away.

And no Polaris up there. The pole's off toward Deneb
At 9.5s the camera whips back down toward the firelit camp in a blur.
right now. Same stars, different centre.

seg: The frame settles on Nora; a deep rumbling roar rolls up from the valley and she freezes, eyes wide.
Hold on. That roar came from the river.
She slowly turns her head toward the river; far below, the lone cave lion walks slowly along the ice, a big pale maneless cat with a thick winter coat.
Cave lion. Down on the ice. Cave paintings almost never show a mane.
The lion stops and lifts its head toward the camp; Nora turns back to the camera, breathing fast.
Gone in a few thousand years. Tonight, it's right there.
clips.physics: The lion is in the frame from the first second and stays far below on the river ice the whole time; it walks slowly with a heavy rolling shoulder gait and never runs, climbs or comes closer. Its paw prints mark the thin snow on the ice behind it.

seg: Nora stands at the terrace edge, exhausted, breath vapor fading fast.
Hour twenty-two. Toes are numb, and that roar settled it.
She glances back at the camp.
Alva left a gap by the fire for me.
She turns and walks to a dwelling doorway, holding the camera back over her shoulder so it shows her ponytail and the doorway, and ducks through the hide flap; the frame goes dark.
I'm not wasting it on a better shot.

seg: Nora sits still, wrapped in furs; behind her Alva sleeps.
Hour twenty-three. Everyone's asleep.
The embers pulse red; Nora breathes slowly.
I've spent ten years measuring this floor in centimetres.
She pulls the furs tighter around herself.
Never thought about how warm it was. It is. Barely.
clips.physics: Nothing moves except the pulsing embers and slow breathing.
clips.join: CUT, time-skip

seg: Nora sits still on the bone, a fur hide around her shoulders; the light slowly grows.
Hour twenty-four. First light.
She flexes her fingers and looks at them.
My hands work, my toes probably work.
She smiles faintly at the horizon.
They do this every single winter. I did one day. One.
